name: DealCloud
description: DealCloud (by Intapp) is a CRM and deal/relationship intelligence platform used by private capital, investment banking, and other professional services firms to manage relationships, pipelines, and deal execution.
gating_notes: API access requires an existing paid DealCloud site/subscription; enterprise pricing is quote-only (contact sales/demo, no self-serve signup). Within a site, an admin must enable 'API' capability for a user group, and the Publications feature must be enabled by the account's DealCloud Customer Success Manager before OAuth client credentials (client_id/client_secret) and a personal API key can be generated.
mcp_notes: Official first-party DealCloud MCP Server (from Integration Appliance/Intapp) is in 'client preview' starting July 2026, documented at api.docs.dealcloud.com/mcp. It gives AI agents read access to DealCloud data (tool discovery, context retrieval, permission-scoped responses) for use cases like pipeline insight and meeting prep.
blocker: No public self-serve credential acquisition — building/testing a Composio toolkit requires a live, paid DealCloud site plus admin-enabled API/Publications access; the official MCP server is also still in limited client preview, not generally available.
